title: Write-up front matter
description: The front matter of a write-up, whose Markdown is the document's body. A hypothesis's write-up covers every attempt, failed ones included, and cites the verification report it reports on: the summary is the one sentence its page opens with. An imported write-up is the retrospective report of an imported attempt, with who wrote it and when.

summary.description: One sentence: the line the hypothesis page opens with.

attempts.description: The sequence numbers of the attempts it covers: every attempt of the hypothesis.

verification.description: The verification report it reports on, by id and SHA-256, as the document job names it; null for a hypothesis stopped after a failure, which has none.

kind.description: `retrospective`: written after the fact, from the run's sources.

written_on.description: The day it was written, when the source gives a day.

written_at.description: The instant it was written, when the source gives an instant.
